N4571A-27-R-0002 Page 13 of 106 Truth-seeking means the LLM is truthful in responding to user prompts seeking factual information or analysis. The LLM prioritizes historical accuracy, scientific inquiry, and objectivity, and acknowledges uncertainty where reliable information is incomplete or contradictory. Ideological Neutrality means the LLM is a neutral, nonpartisan tool that does not manipulate responses in favor of ideological dogmas. Significant Modifications means any changes made by the contractor or subcontractor to the AI model that could reasonably be expected to alter its adherence to the Unbiased AI Principles. For the purposes of compliance with the Unbiased AI Principles, this definition includes, but is not limited to, changes to training data and model architecture, and alterations to filtering and content moderation. (b) Contractor Obligation. The contractor must ensure that any LLM or other AI model provided under this contract complies with the Unbiased AI Principles throughout the period of performance. Scope of Works The proposed project comprises constructing a new two-storey training building (gross internal floor area 700 sqm approx.), alterations to the BA building & new training tower, new storage shed & gas compound and upgrade works to external yard. The site is a brownfield site (adjacent to existing dwellings). The proposed new building is a two-storey structure comprised of RC column and beam construction with composite cladding finish. Construction comprises concrete ground beams on CFA piles, blockwork rising walls, concrete floor slab, metal stud partitions internal walls, insulated composite cladding panels to external walls, pre-cast concrete first floor and roof slab, external double-glazed windows and doors, internal doors and screens, mechanical and electrical services, internal floor, wall, and ceiling finishes, flat roof finish, decoration internally, and associated external works. Design Team An IDT team has been appointed for the project, the full Project Team members are as follows: SELECTION CRITERIA Works Contractor Suitability The Contracting Authority is seeking a contractor capable of delivering the new works within a live operational fire station campus

Im Falle der Kündigung aus wichtigem Grund hat der Auftragnehmer Anspruch auf Vergütung für die bis zum Wirksamwerden der Kündigung aufgrund des Vertrages erbrachten Leistungen. Die Vergütung entfällt aber für solche Leistungen, für die der Auftraggeber darlegt, dass sie für ihn aufgrund der Kündigung ohne Interesse sind. 21 Haftpflichtversicherung 21.1 Soweit vereinbart, weist der Auftragnehmer bei Abschluss des Vertrages dem Auft raggeber nach, dass er über eine im Rahmen und Umfang marktübliche Industriehaftpflichtversicherung oder eine vergleichbare Versicherung aus einem Mitgliedsstaat der EU verfügt. 21.2 Der Auftragnehmer wird diesen Versicherungsschutz bis zum Ende des Vertrages und darüber hinaus bis zur Verjährung sämtlicher Mängelansprüche aufrechterhalten. Kommt der Auftragnehmer dieser Verpflichtung nicht nach, ist der Auftraggeber nach erfolgloser angemessener Fristsetzung zur Kündigung des Vertrages berechtigt, wenn ihm ein Festhalten am Vertrag nicht

Rechnungsbegründende Anlagen müssen Base64-kodiert sein und können in den folgenden Formaten zur E-Rechnung hinzugefügt werden: PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, CSV, XLSX, ODS. Alle Anlagen müssen unterschiedliche Namen haben. Dies betrifft auch eingebettete, Base64 codierte Anlagen innerhalb der E- Rechnung. Die Dateinamen dürfen kein @-Zeichen enthalten und werden ggf. abgeschnitten, wenn sie zu lang sind. Es darf nur eine Rechnung pro E-Mail eingereicht werden, die Gesamtgröße inkl. aller Anhänge darf 20 MB nicht überschreiten. Genauere Infos und Angaben dazu, was Sie noch bei der Einreichung beachten sollten, finden Sie hier. deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/ACC-APG_Digital_IF_Call_for_Solutions_12Nov2026_Amendmnt_0002.docx ===== Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Call for Solutions (CfS) for Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) SECTION 1 - INTRODUCTION BACKGROUND Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) is seeking solutions for a Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Digital Intermediate Frequency (IF) system to satisfy the requirements for Increment 1 of this modernization effort. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Technical Assistance Facility under the Learning Acceleration in Secondary Education (LAISE) Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include undertaking a comprehensive assessment of ICT infrastructure and institutional readiness, the status and readiness of Multimedia Classrooms (MMCs), and teachers’ competencies and readiness to deliver ICT-enabled teaching using ICT facilities and MMCs.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.dshe.gov.bd or can be obtained at the address given below. The duration of the assignment will be about 06 (Six) months. The assignment is expected to commence in March 2027.

The Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education now invites eligible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The Contractor, not the Government, is responsible for management and quality control to meet the terms of the contract. deliverables_scope.text: VA has a requirement to purchase Autotransfusion Units to deliver patient care to its VA Medical Centers around the country. An Autotransfusion Units also known as an autologous blood recovery system, is a system that provides hospitals with an easy-to-use, reliable way to recover a patient’s own high-quality blood during medium to high blood loss procedures, including cardiac, orthopedic, trauma, transplant, vascular and OBGYN surgeries. Once recovered, the blood is washed and delivered to a product bag. The complete system is designed to be intuitive and flexible for optimal performance, supporting exceptional patient care.
